name: 瞳孔动力学分析
description: 分析瞳孔扩张模式、反射和同步性，以检测AI生成的面部。
useCase: Detecting 深度伪造s through unnatural pupil behavior and missing light reflexes
mechanism: Tracks pupil size changes, pupillary light reflex, and consensual response 跨 video frames. Real pupils dynamically respond to light changes and cognitive load. AI生成的 eyes often have static pupils, irregular shapes, or missing pupillary reflexes.
accuracy: 高 - 82-92% on face generation 深度伪造s
source: Guo, Y. et al. (2022) - Exposing Deepfake Face Forgeries with Guided Residuals, IEEE TMM
algorithm: Iris/Pupil Segmentation + Dilation Tracking + Light Response Correlation
parameters: Pupil 检测: circular Hough transform, Tracking: Kalman filter, Light 分析: 亮度 相关性
